title: Alcazar is worth a visit
text: Highly recommend the tour and Maria, our guide, was excellent. We did the tour at 6pm, which was perfect as cooler and the light was lovely. Good value for money.

title: Visit to the Real Alcazar
text: The guide was truly exceptional, a very good tour.

title: An excellent experience
text:
Tania leads us through the Alcazar while telling us the history of the monument. Very interesting.

She then offered for us to visit the gardens and the baths before our departure.

title: Loved it

author: Michelle_s

title: Beautiful!!
text: The palace is beautiful, and the guide is very skilled, knowledgeable, and friendly. The experience at 8:49 in the morning, without the crowd, is very exciting, and one can savor the uniqueness of the palace!!
author: Virginia_C

title: Spectacular sights with a great guide
text: We loved the tour.  Filipe was engaging and knowledgeable and made the tour a pleasure.  The palaces are breathtaking and we were able to visit before opening so the crowd was just us.  Highly recommend this tour.
author: Alec_H

title: Alcazar visit
text: Very well organized. Guides were very knowledgable and spent time to explain every detail. It worth the money.

title: Great tour
text: Filippo was an excellent guide, very knowledgeable about the history.   Audio headsets were very helpful.
